faqs.question: How do I submit a request?
faqs.answer: You can submit a new request online in a few simple steps. Start by entering your basic details, then add a short summary and your Order ID. After submission, your case is created and you receive a reference ID so you can track progress.

faqs.question: How can I track my request?
faqs.answer: You can check the status of your request at any time. This helps you stay informed as your case moves through stages such as received, under review, and completed.

faqs.question: How do I request an amendment?
faqs.answer: If you need to update a request you have already submitted, you can request an amendment without starting over. Once your changes are reviewed and approved, the updated information will be applied to your case.

faqs.question: How do I book or reschedule an RX slot?
faqs.answer: You can book or reschedule an RX slot for doctor or treatment appointments based on your travel plans and prior prescription needs. This service is designed to help you secure a confirmed slot with minimal waiting.

faqs.question: How do I upload supporting documents?
faqs.answer: If you have been asked for files, or if you need to add supporting documents to your case, you can upload them securely through Drop Docs. Uploaded files are attached to your case so the relevant reviewer can access them.

faqs.question: How do I get enterprise support?
faqs.answer: If you need help with an active business or service-related case, you can contact Enterprise Assist. Share your case details so the support team can review and guide you quickly.
requirements: Brief description of the issue or goal

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: You can book an appointment through customer-service for supported services. Once you choose your preferred slot and provide the required details, you will receive confirmation based on availability.
requirements: Relevant request or case information, if applicable

faqs.question: How do I leave a review?
faqs.answer: You can leave a review after using a service to share your experience with us. Your feedback helps improve service quality and supports future customers.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept secure digital payments through the options available at checkout. Depending on the service or platform, methods may include UPI, debit cards, credit cards, net banking, and other supported digital payment methods.

faqs.question: What are your business hours?
faqs.answer: Our online team is available Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST. Outside these hours, you can still use the customer-service portal for routine tasks at any time.

faqs.question: Is there a mobile app?
faqs.answer: Yes. WECARE.DIGITAL offers an app for iOS and Android so users can track requests, book services, upload documents, make payments, and get support in one place.

faqs.question: What is WECARE.DIGITAL?
faqs.answer: WECARE.DIGITAL is a network of microservice brands serving everyday Bharat across travel, paperwork, disputes, rituals, and reflection. It focuses on simple access, transparent pricing, and reliable service through Elsewhere, Expo Week, Dastavez, Clear Closure, Ritual Guru, Anew, and Grahak OS.

faqs.question: Can I buy a gift card?
faqs.answer: Yes. WECARE.DIGITAL offers e-gift cards that can be sent instantly with a selected amount and message.

faqs.question: How do I place an order?
faqs.answer: Browse products at https://wecare.digital/shop/. Verify your WhatsApp number on the website to continue to checkout.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: Razorpay Standard Checkout supports UPI, cards and net banking when checkout is available. Review the final taxes and 2.5% convenience fee before paying.
faqs.shortAnswer: Razorpay: UPI, cards and net banking

faqs.question: What are your delivery options?
faqs.answer: We offer standard shipping across India. Delivery time varies by location (typically 3-7 business days). Track your order status in the My Orders section.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: Returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery for eligible items. Contact us at one@wecare.digital with your order number to initiate a return. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days.

faqs.question: How do I track my order?
faqs.answer: Visit https://wecare.digital/orders/ and contact us with your order reference for the current status.

faqs.question: Can I order via WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: Use WhatsApp to verify your number at https://wecare.digital/account/sign-in/ and contact us for help. Browse products at https://wecare.digital/shop/; payment checkout is on the website.

faqs.question: How do I get my invoice?
faqs.answer: For a receipt from an existing payment, contact us with your order reference through https://wecare.digital/orders/.
faqs.shortAnswer: Contact us with your order reference

faqs.question: How do I create an account?
faqs.answer: Verify your WhatsApp number at https://wecare.digital/account/sign-in/ to continue to your cart or orders.
faqs.shortAnswer: Verify your WhatsApp number at wecare.digital/account/sign-in/

faqs.question: What is the convenience fee?
faqs.answer: The checkout policy uses a 2.5% convenience fee on the approved collection amount and 18% GST on that fee. Review the server-confirmed tax and fee breakdown before payment.

faqs.question: Do you offer bulk order discounts?
faqs.answer: Yes! For bulk orders, please contact us at one@wecare.digital or call +91 9330994400. We offer special pricing for large quantities.
